name: 993 front lid, composite skin with load-path (bionic) inner frame, gyroid core (PicoGK)
material_candidate: organic matrix composite (glass, carbon or hybrid), layup to be determined
picogk_enhancement: Gyroid core: the published PicoGK body (bionic_topology) keeps its outer form; a 3 mm skin encloses a sheet gyroid (22.5 mm cell, 2.5 mm wall) wherever the body holds three cells, thinner zones and functional features stay solid, drain ports run to the nearest outer surface and any pocket they miss is filled solid. Core settings are assumptions for the composite class; nothing here is printed, depowdered or tested.

cell_mm.note: gyroid period; at least 9 walls so the channels stay open to the drains

wall_mm.note: gyroid sheet thickness; class minimum 1.0 mm, at least 2.5 voxels

skin_mm.note: outer skin; class minimum 1.5 mm, at least 3 voxels

min_cells.note: owner rule 2026-10-22: core only where three cells fit, else solid

drain_d_mm.note: powder/resin drain diameter; class minimum 3.0 mm

max_drains.note: lowest and highest core points, then farthest-point spread

reapply_bionic_features_note: bionic.json lists tiled design regions, not features; the published PicoGK body already carries every opening, and the skin wraps all of them
open_interfaces: hinge interfaces (positions, fasteners) - not measured, not drawn
latch and safety catch interface - not measured, not drawn
gap and flush to fenders, bumper and cowl - not measured
true surface: to be taken from a sound, undeformed original panel (scan)
status: F0 concept geometry - not fitted, not tested, not safe, not released, not a print file
